cohort: The study included 200 normal term newborns from a tertiary care hospital in northern India at an altitude of more than 3000 feet above sea level.
finding: The study established mean cord blood hematological parameters for normal term Indian neonates born at high altitude, finding a significant gender difference only in hemoglobin but no impact from mode of delivery on other parameters.
mod_finding: The mode of delivery had no significant impact on the differences in the various hematological values.
